stableFactsAndClaims: The panel gathers local drafts and identifying information; the member demonstration is June 2, with a written guide afterward for absentees.
Recovery copies stay on the same device and help after an unexpected tab closure; they are not independent backups and do not protect against device loss or storage failure.
The panel shows title, last local save time, and approximate size; contents appear only through Preview.
Preview opens saved text beside the current document, replaces neither, and can close without committing a change.
Restore requires title confirmation and creates a new document; the current document stays open and documents are not merged automatically.
Blocked browser storage means no local copies; no substitute is silently uploaded to the server.
Shared-device users should clear local copies because another person using the same browser profile may preview them.
The session and guide cover previewing, restoring, removing copies, and availability conditions.
authorizedFactualChanges: Every two minutes becomes every five minutes.
requiredForm: Member announcement retaining its existing tone.
